+        app((a + b, chr(idx), a, b))
+    return table
+
+
+def _apply_table(s, table):
+    """
+    Replace every pair of a _replace_table in order. A pass can only change s
+    if both code points of its pair occur in s, so passes are skipped when one
+    is missing from present (a superset of the code points of s: minted ones
+    are added, consumed ones are never removed), saving a full scan each.
+    """
+    present = set(s)
+    add = present.add
+    for ps, c, a, b in table:
+        if a in present and b in present:
+            t = s.replace(ps, c)
+            if t is not s:
+                s = t
+                add(c)
+    return s
